note: Brands whose CURRENT failing run is a confirmed known issue in the test script itself (not a real product bug). Each entry is scoped to appliesToDate — the exact date of the run it acknowledges. If that brand's latest run moves to a new date, the entry stops applying automatically and the brand goes back to full 'Needs attention' alarm until someone re-confirms the new failure and adds a fresh entry. This is deliberate: a stale note must never silently mask a genuinely new failure just because it landed on the same brand.
